body.capacity_plan_summary: Focused capacity execution plan: first reproduce/fix retained-ownership undercount in compact status, then seven real-process acceptance cases and one real dashboard capacity flow. Uses the existing portable CI from PRs #16/#18. No application tests or runtime experiments performed during planning.
body.summary: Source coverage audit and joint verification plan for independent switching and server capacity: real isolated controller/SQLite/Git/process integration, five real browser scenarios, deterministic cleanup/capacity regressions, portable CI coordination and remaining resource/owner evidence. Identifies a source-level compact capacity undercount after unconfirmed cleanup; no runtime reproduction, application tests or deployment performed.

title: Multi-project integration and real browser E2E analysis and plan
